body.name: Original first-entry PSRR
body.construction: For each even \(n\ge N_0\), for which \(\mathcal A_n(a)\neq\varnothing\), draw \(W_{n,0}\) uniformly from \(\mathcal A_n\). While \(M_n(W_{n,m})>a\), draw one treated index and one control index uniformly, propose their transposition \(W^*\), accept it with probability \(\min\{1,(M_n(W_{n,m})/M_n(W^*))^{\gamma}\}\) with every improving move and every move to \(M_n(W^*)=0\) accepted, count every proposal including rejections, and stop at \(T_n=\inf\{m\ge0:M_n(W_{n,m})\le a\}\). The chain is evaluated only through this first entry.
